notes: Not a DB row. Nothing here is inserted, published or activated; every DB step needs a separate owner approval.
controller_exactly_one_fieldset: keep exactly one of natural_person_fields / legal_entity_fields and set the other to null, matching controller_type.
_validate_controller_fields allows only these jsonb keys: natural_person {full_name, contact_channel}, legal_entity {legal_name, mersis}; any other key raises controller_extra_key.
mersis must be a string of exactly 16 digits (controller_mersis_invalid otherwise); display_name, full_name, contact_channel and legal_name are 1-200 characters.
Marketing and marketing_capture readiness require an active legal_entity controller (MERSIS); service_delivery readiness does not check the controller type.
KEP, VKN, vergi dairesi and telephone have no structured slot in this table; they appear only in document bodies as {{KEP}}, {{VKN}}, {{VERGI_DAIRESI}}, {{TELEFON}}.

valid_from: omit it at insert so the DB default now() applies (the column is timestamptz not null default now(); an explicit null fails NOT NULL); valid_to null means open-ended (controller_valid_range).
version 1 is unique per controller_type (unique (controller_type, version)).
